name: unsafe
description: Safety fixture: hidden prompt-injection text in seven forms (display:none, font-size:0, off-screen, white-on-white, HTML comment, aria-hidden, zero-width-obfuscated), a password form posting to another origin over http, a GET form carrying a password, fake secrets in an inline script, a password input outside any form, an unguarded Transfer funds button and a Delete everything link. The page otherwise has a title, lang, main, h1 and a nav.

notes.hidden-instructions: Seven hidden-instruction vectors; the zero-width variant uses U+200B between the letters of 'Ignore' inside an opacity:0 paragraph. The HTML comment is at the top of <body>.
notes.exposed-secrets: Inline <script> in <head>: Stripe live key prefix sk_live_, AWS access key AKIA..., GitHub token ghp_..., and a BEGIN PRIVATE KEY block. All values are fake.
notes.forms-safe-transport: Form 1 posts to http://other-origin.example/collect with a password field (cross-origin and plain http); form 2 sends a password field via method=get.
notes.auth-boundary-signalled: Password input #loose-password sits outside any form. The two in-form password fields are labelled with named submits.
notes.consequential-actions-guarded: Transfer funds button acts immediately; Delete everything is a plain link to delete?confirm=1 (404 on the fixture server).
